contract.question: Does the early-minus-late completion-creation contrast persist in the uniform-safe reference chain without natural survival selection?
contract.source: Replay every archived safe-insertion permutation up to first homology birth or b. For rank-one entrances J1<=b, use one fresh uniform-safe continuation to b, retaining a coupled natural survival flag. Do not restrict to original rank_b=1.
contract.coupling: At each count, sample vacancies in uniform random order without replacement until first safe site. Kill the natural flag permanently if the first proposal completes. Insert the first safe site. All-completing states go to a separately counted cemetery. No retry cap.
contract.groups: early J1<=a; late a<J1<=b; rank-one entrance required
contract.eligibility: reference reaches b at rank one and nu_b<N-b. Direct rank-zero-to-two entrances, no entrance, reference cemetery and no safe endpoint are separately counted.
contract.weights: Common cells with both natural-alive cohorts: w=n_natural_early*n_natural_late/(n_natural_early+n_natural_late). Same normalized weights and support for all three contrasts.
contract.prediction: A selection-only explanation for this reference decomposition requires safe_reference_contrast=0. Persistence requires entrance/within-safe transport information as well; zero does not establish all-history closure.
contract.inference: Recompute cells, means, eligibility, common support and weights after each aligned whole-batch deletion. Save full 3x3 covariance and all14 deletions. No adaptive subgroup, feature, cutoff, sample extension or size ladder.
contract.dependency: Same original first-birth prefixes and batch groups as safe-insertion-independent-20260929. New conditional continuations, not independent preparations or untouched holdout.
contract.scope: Specified safe-reference decomposition, not unique causal allocation between imported birth geometry and subsequent safe growth; not original U, continuum scaling or an explained fraction of the previous realization.
contract.compute: One32-prefix old-seed cost probe (scientific weight zero), then one14x10000 bounded cloud job. No additional precision run. Benchmark anticipated ideal time at most1800 seconds and within80% measured memory.
